items.label: Protec Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Products and R&D per the half-year report: Protec lists a laser bonder (2024)

set.signal: Products and R&D per the half-year report: Protec lists a laser bonder (2024) that uses a laser heat source from below to bond high-performance chips such as GPU logic dies or HBM onto interposers or PCB substrates, with sales generated; a next-generation laser-assisted bonder (2022) using an in-house large-area laser source and controller in place of imported parts, with sales generated; a Micro Solder Ball Attachment System (2022, Minami) with sales; and a Copper Pin Attachment System (2025, Minami) for high-aspect-ratio copper pins replacing solder balls. It signed a technology-royalty agreement on 2024-12-21 under which it pays an undisclosed overseas company A for use of A's technology, for sales beyond that counterparty. The report states demand for HBM and 2.5D/3D heterogeneous packaging keeps rising and HBM and related advanced-packaging equipment demand is expected to expand, and that the company is developing bonder and laser-application equipment for future growth. Consolidated R&D spend KRW 7,447,334K = 5.3% of revenue; patents held 318.

items.signal_prefix: Supplier: Tokai Carbon Korea buys its main raw material, high-p

set.signal: Supplier: Tokai Carbon Korea buys its main raw material, high-purity graphite, from its parent Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. (Japan), with unit prices negotiated each year in yen; H1 raw-material purchases were graphite KRW 14,206M (95.0%) and graphite foil etc. KRW 754M (5.0%). Related-party purchases from Tokai Carbon Co., Ltd. were KRW 12,569,838K in H1 2026 (H1 2025: KRW 15,699,911K) and technology royalties under a 2019 technology licence (10 years from 2019-01-01, auto-renewing) KRW 5,100,690K (KRW 3,687,442K). A sales-support fee agreement with KC Co. (2% of Solid SiC ring sales; KRW 2,988,772K in H1) was amended on 2026-03-31 to end on 2026-12-31 without renewal. Sales to group affiliate Tokai Carbon (Dalian) were KRW 5,306,338K.
